title: Bedaquiline
dek: Diarylquinoline, AtpE binder, Group A. Dosed 400 mg daily × 2 weeks then 200 mg three times weekly (or daily 200 mg in some SOPs). Watch QTc, liver, and Rv0678.
story: Bedaquiline resurrected DR-TB therapy by targeting ATP synthase. It is the B in BPaLM/BPaL, BDLLfxC, BLMZ, and the 2022 9-month. Standard adult loading: 400 mg daily for 14 days, then 200 mg Monday/Wednesday/Friday through week 24 (or operational daily 200 mg — follow the handbook you are actually using).
Resistance: rare high-level atpE, common-ish Rv0678 LOF, pepQ. Cross-R with clofazimine via the pump. MIC plus catalogue; CC alone is blunt.

Host: QTc (additive with FQ/CFZ/DLM), hepatitis, a black-box mortality debate from the original trial that programmes still mention while using the drug because the alternative was 20-month injectables. CYP3A4 substrate — no rifampin coadministration.
deep: Long terminal half-life: the drug is still around after you stop it. That is a feature for adherence and a bug for lingering selection.
Pediatric weight bands exist. Pregnancy: BDQ is used in 2025 Pa-sparing constructs.
Do not start BDQ “to be modern” in DS-TB. HPMZ and HRZE do not contain it.

visual.caption: BDQ exposure as a loaded then sparse maintenance schedule (schematic). Resistance loci sit outside the PK plate on purpose: atpE vs Rv0678 are not dosing errors.

steps.title: CYP3A4 induction will eat BDQ
steps.body: Rifampin and BDQ are not companions. Stop RIF; know that induction lingers days to weeks.

steps.title: You are now in an RR algorithm

example.takeaway: BDQ is Group A ATP-synthase chemistry with a long tail and a pump problem.
